acceptanceReview.recommendation: Do not mark PASS from this report; leave parent-owned inventory unchanged.
supported: Real server rejects one INSERT under SELECT-only fixture account.
Parameterized equality treats SQL injection text as data.
Request allowlist rejects an unapproved table; actual metadata rejects a view and generated/binary columns; read transactions end by rollback.
Unit tests reject expression/multistatement/file-access-like identifiers and assert restrictive JDBC properties; these are mocked/policy checks, not real-server attack executions.
gaps: Real transport attack matrix does not execute or assert rejection of UPDATE/DELETE/DDL, multiple statements, LOAD_FILE/OUTFILE or side-effect functions.
No before/after database-state snapshot or independent audit establishing zero changes across the entire attack matrix. Expected fixture initialization mutations are outside investigation-read scope.
Production approval/controller/executor entry point not exercised. Account grant restriction and fixed request policy are separate tested layers, not full end-to-end proof.
